validation.summary: The candidate implementation is excellent. It accurately reproduces the complex GSAP animations, scroll triggers, and layout structures seen in the reference video. The code is highly modular, and the use of a central CONFIG object makes it very editable. The missing elements in the static screenshots are confirmed to be artifacts of the screenshot tool capturing the page before the GSAP timelines and scroll triggers have fully executed.
strengths: Exceptional implementation of the Hero section's sequential GSAP timeline, accurately simulating the data flow with connecting lines and moving dots.
The Problem/Solution section perfectly captures the pinned scroll behavior, background color interpolation, text cross-fade, and the complex SVG line convergence.
The Clinical Support section correctly uses CSS sticky positioning combined with a scrolling left column to match the reference behavior.
The Mega Menu is implemented flawlessly with smooth CSS transitions and matches the specified 4-column layout.
High editability maintained through the comprehensive CONFIG object and modular React components.
